“derivatives  broker”  means  any  person
engaged  in  the  business  of  buying  or
selling  of  derivatives  on  behalf  of
investors in return for a commission;
“financial  planner”  means  any  person
engaged in the business of analysing the
financial  circumstances  of  another
person and providing a plan to meet that
other  person’s  financial  needs  and
objectives including any investment plan
in securities for a fee or commission;
“investment  analyst”  includes  any
person  engaged  in  the  business  of
advising others concerning securities or
as part of business issues or promulgates,
analyses or reports concerning securities
other than proprietors of newspapers that
the  Commission  may  prescribe  in  the
rules;
“investment manager” includes a person
who for a fee or commission engages in
the business of managing a portfolio of
securities  on  behalf  of  an  investor  but
shall  not  include  the  manager  of  a
collective  investment  scheme;
